name: tether_puffer_precision_v001
hypothesis: Longer settling plus smooth millimeter-scale destination shaping may improve sustained payload precision; uncalibrated simulation only.
algorithm: PufferLib 3 PuffeRL transferred Gaussian residual controller
notes: PufferLib 3 compatibility migration retaining NavigationTaskV2 MuJoCo physics, privileged state and rotor/deck/cable contact checks. Transfer V007 final policy, optimizer and normalization. Observation/reward statistics frozen; upstream clamps training reward to [-1,1]. Finite duration treated as terminal because PufferLib 3 advantage kernel ignores separate truncations. Different PPO variant, value clipping, no strict equivalence to SB3. CUDA policy and updates; compiled advantage kernel also runs on CUDA; Four CPU-only MuJoCo workers (two environments each) fork before CUDA initialization to share library memory. Uncalibrated hardware assumptions. No seconds-scale speed or learning improvement claim. New version: 90-second episodes; full 3D payload error <=1mm for 3 continuous seconds, payload speed <=5mm/s, completed route and no crash. Smooth destination shaping; historical success/reward scales are not comparable.
